name: session-handoff-button-mod
description: A Claude Code mod: a context-colored Session Hand-off button that writes a handoff, clears, and continues in a fresh session with one press, plus a one-time warning past 65% context.

plugins.name: session-handoff-button
plugins.description: A Session Hand-off button above the prompt, green/orange/red by context usage (45% and 65% thresholds). While green it reads Context clean and cannot be pressed; from orange on, one press runs your handoff skill (or a built-in prompt), saves the handoff to a temp .md, runs /clear and continues in the fresh session with a short message, the handoff riding along as hidden context. Past 65% it stops your next prompt once and recommends the button. Reach L2: drives Claude (one handoff turn, /clear, one prompt); writes one temp file per handoff; no processes or network.
